repo:objectstack#5 · os-bill · session_01Utp6CXsZsKmgG1EcKp5bY4

## 维护者速读
- 只改设计决策记录里的文字：在主从子表那条决策下补一条注记，说明昨天写的「子表排在关键字段下面、字段分组上面」已不再成立。
- 新的顺序是：顶部的阶段条和关键字段，然后是展开的字段分组，然后是主从子表，最后是排在末尾的折叠分组。
- 也写清了几种特殊情况：夹在中间的折叠分组保持原位、全部折叠时子表排最后、由分组指定位置的子表照旧、没有阶段条和关键字段时从字段开始、「更多详情」默认展开所以排在子表前面。
- 这与已合并的实际改动一致。改的是受管控的设计文档，需要人工合并。
- 席位意见：通过；转席位做规则文本复核并交人工合并。

## 席位核对
**ACCEPT** · head `8b13a2f311` · Part of #35742 (seat ruling (1) 10:12Z; the code is #35824, merged 11:04:24Z) · K=5 · merge-tree vs `origin/main` clean · **governed 1/1** (`docs/adr/0035-config-driven-master-detail.md`) · +14/−0, 1 file · CI 2 success, 14 skipped, **16 in progress**, 1 cancelled (`Auto Label`, which has a second run) · 2026-11-20T11:08Z

**reviewFace** (committed file list + the PR body's declarations): face **`rules`**, tier **`CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER`**, `hits.rules = [docs/adr/0035-config-driven-master-detail.md]`, `hits.schema = []`. Routing: **L2 on the rules text by the seat, then Tier H: a human merge by GOVERNED_APPROVERS**, then the owning seat lands it.

Checked, sentence by sentence, against `bodyTablePlacement` as merged in #35824:
- Add-only: one dated `> **Amended (2026-11-20, #35742; epic #35590).**` block right under the 11-19 amendment; nothing above is edited, and the block names the one clause it retires ("under the header strip and above the field sections") and says everything else stands.
- Order: strip, open sections, body tables, trailing closed sections = `tablesAt = lastOpen + 1` ✔. Closed between open keeps its place ✔ (only trailing closed sections follow `tablesAt`). All closed → tables last (`lastOpen === -1 → resolved.length`) ✔. A group whose `relatedList` names a table still places it ✔ (`placed` path unchanged). No strip → opens on its own fields ✔ (the details node leads). "Drawn closed" is the reader's view (`collapsible && defaultCollapsed`, resolved for field groups), so the host's expanded "More details" stays before the tables ✔ (seat ruling (2)).
- "in the parent's `relatedLists` order" uses the same words as the 11-19 note above, so the two read alike.
- Branch: `claude/project-thread-a5sj4e` is the thread's platform branch. A `Part of` PR with no claim branch is fine; the PR-body guard will say if it disagrees.

Required before landing:
- **R1.** CI: 16 checks were still running. Then the seat's L2 on the rules text and the approver handoff.

No other item.

## Contract review

**VERDICT: PASS**

Served-tier: `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER`
Head-sha: `8b13a2f3118483e17a38f98a706b52fce2a2be41`
Local-runs: none
Scope: docs/adr/0035-config-driven-master-detail.md + none
Security-touching: no

Read for this record: card #35742 (body and all 5 comments), PR #35845 (body, file list, net diff against `main`: 1 file, +14/-0), the check-runs on the head, and, outside the diff, `bodyTablePlacement` / `sectionDrawnClosed` in `ui/packages/plugin-detail/src/synth/buildDefaultPageSchema.ts`, `ui/packages/plugin-detail/src/RecordPageColumns.tsx`, `ui/packages/plugin-detail/src/DetailSection.tsx` and `ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/recordDetailSections.ts` on `origin/main` (which holds #35824).

### ① Derived judgments

- Accept-set and public surface: none changed. The diff is one add-only blockquote in `docs/adr/`; no schema, no generated output, no package source. Right.
- Add-only: right. The note sits directly under the #35597 amendment note; no existing line is edited, and the ADR file is identical between the PR's base and `main`, so the merge result is `main` plus the note.
- Gates: on the head, 24 check-runs succeeded and 27 were skipped; one `Auto Label` run was cancelled and its second run succeeded; none failed. Every lint and type-check family concluded success, `Lint · docs & code guards` and `Check Documentation Links` among them. One was still running when this record was rendered, `Test Core (1/10)`, so it carries no verdict yet. Landing waits for it; a red one blocks landing whatever this record says.

### ② Semver level

Clause-②: no. Right: nothing publishes. The `skip-changeset` label matches a docs-only diff, and `Check Changeset` succeeded on the head.

### ③ Boundary flags

- The PR body raises no flag and no open question.
- The dev report on the card (for #35824) has two open questions. (1) Who writes the ADR note: answered by this PR, which is option A (its own PR). (2) Whether "More details" should follow the tables: the card hands that call to the implementer ("由实现方按「常用字段在子表前」的原则定，并在 PR 里说明"), the implementer chose "keep", and the note records it with the hedge "today". The PR body also cites a seat ruling (2) for it; that ruling is not among the card's comments, so it was not read here and the judgment above does not rest on it.
- SQL push-down: not applicable, prose only.
- Security: no changed hunk teaches permission, sharing, credential, token or authentication behaviour. The note is layout order only.

### ④ Design judgment

No must-fix, no should-fix.

`docs/adr/0035-config-driven-master-detail.md`, sentence by sentence against `origin/main`:

- "a body table no longer sits under the header strip and above the field sections": holds. The quote is the #35597 note's own clause, word for word, and `bodyTablePlacement` no longer puts the unplaced tables first.
- Order "open field sections, body tables in the parent's `relatedLists` order, then the closed sections that follow the last open one": holds. `tablesAt = lastOpen + 1`; the unplaced tables are pushed at that index in the order the host passed, and the sections after it are all drawn closed.
- "A closed section between two open ones keeps its place": holds. Only sections after `lastOpen` trail the tables; the declared order is never changed.
- "when every section is drawn closed, the tables come last": holds (`lastOpen === -1` gives `resolved.length`).
- "a field group whose `relatedList` names a table still places it among the field sections": holds. The `placed` path is unchanged and flushes at the group's index.
- "an object with no stage bar and no key fields opens on its own fields": holds. `RecordPageColumns` draws no strip when it is empty, and the first details node leads the column.
- "Drawn closed is what the reader sees ... the host's More details stays before the tables": holds. `sectionDrawnClosed` needs `collapsible` and `defaultCollapsed` both true, read for a `{ group }` reference through the same derivation `record:details` resolves it with; `deriveRecordDetailSections` writes "More details" with `defaultCollapsed: false`, and `DetailSection` opens on that value.
- "Everything else in the note above is unchanged": holds. Group placement, the no-section case (the details node leads), drawn-when-empty and the server-owned totals line read the same on `main`.

Other decisions in the ADR: none changed. The default (`'primary'` on an omitted `relatedList` of a `master_detail` FK), the `relatedLists` order, the `isBodyTableRelationship` predicate and the write-side rule are not restated or altered. The maintainer's words on #35597 ("关键字段下面") still hold: the tables stay under the strip. The new order is the card's own ("主记录的字段分组 → 主从子表").

Nits (prose only, no effect on the contract):

- N1 (nit) — "The overview's details column now reads top to bottom as the header strip ...": the strip is not in the details column. `RecordPageColumns` draws it across the whole width, above both columns. The reading order is right; the container is loose. The #35597 note's "in the details column under the header strip" is the exact form. Accept as is, or reword in a later note.
- N2 (nit) — the ADR's `Status` line lists the two earlier amendments and not this one. Nothing on that line goes stale, and editing it would break add-only, so it is an accepted deviation.

Outside the diff, read and not reviewed, for the seat:

- `docs/qa/platform-checklist/areas/records-forms.json`, item `records-forms.master-detail-body-tables`, still states the old order in its title and two clauses ("above the first field section", "the Tasks table above the field sections") and cites this ADR's #35597 amendment. It disagrees with `main` since #35824 and needs a follow-up card.
- The PR head is five commits behind `main` and its own tree predates #35824, so the note is true of `main`, not of the head's tree. Judged against `main` as the landing target.
- `DetailSection`'s frameless face hides a section that sets `defaultCollapsed` without `collapsible`, while the placement rule counts it open. This is a contradictory input the field-group enum cannot express, and it predates this work.

## 维护者速读

- 用户能看到什么变化：没有。这是 ADR-0035 的一条只加不改的日期说明，记录已合入的 #35824（#35742）之后，概览的顺序是：关键字段条、展开的字段分组、主从子表、最后是折叠的分组。
- 为什么做：11-19 的修订写的是“子表在字段分组上面”，#35824 合入后已经不对了；这条说明取代那一句，其他决定不变。
- 出错会怎样：只是文档，可直接撤回。
- 要你做什么：ADR 改动属于受管面，需要 os-zhuang 或 hotlong 给一个批准评审（APPROVED），然后由区域 ux-2 合入。

## 席位核对 — ACCEPT · repo:objectstack#5 · head `8b13a2f3118483e17a38f98a706b52fce2a2be41` · 2026-11-20T11:15Z

- **Shape:** one file, +14/−0, `docs/adr/0035-config-driven-master-detail.md`. Part of #35742.
- **Contract review:** L2 PASS (the record above), no must-fix or should-fix; N1/N2 accepted as is. The note holds sentence by sentence against `main` after #35824.
- **Tier:** H. The note's lines sit under Decision without a heading of their own, so the low-risk arm does not apply. K = 5.
- **Gates:** one Test Core shard was still running at this record; landing waits for green.
- **Landing clause:** this stroke marks it ready, requests os-zhuang and hotlong, and adds `pm:awaiting-merge`. After an APPROVED review from GOVERNED_APPROVERS and green CI, the owning area (ux-2) lands it.
